title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Patricio is a Senior Clinical Instructor and Director of the Wage Theft Practice at the Harvard legal Aid Bureau. He has been at HLAB since 2011. Before that, he was an Assistant Attorney General in the Civil Rights Division of the Massachusetts Attorney General’s Office. From 2004 to 2008, he worked in the Housing Unit […]
